what_happened: The agent running Athena wanted to resume the kept candidate for the timing-measurement request. It stopped the drain twice, about 2 hours in all, without first checking that Athena would allow a resume. `athena go` refused because of a stale low-disk hold. `athena retry` refused because the line had already been retried as 20261116-041223-m3vc. Nothing was resumed, and the stop cost about 2 hours of drain time. The agent had relied on the hold message's hint that retry "does the same by hand". It had not checked how retry treats a line that was already retried.
cause: The agent acted on shared state without resolving what it referred to, and Athena does not guard against it. Here the state was whether a held line could still be resumed. A hold message hints that retry does the same by hand, but it does not say whether the line was already retried or whether retry and go would refuse. Nothing shows the line's retry state or the expected outcome before the drain is interrupted. The only guard is the agent's habit of checking the authoritative state first.
other_causes: The low-disk hold was stale, and its message pointed to a command that no longer applied.
Stopping the drain is not a dry run. Athena offers no way to check beforehand whether go or retry would be accepted.
open_hypotheses: The input does not say whether a dry-run or status view would have shown that the line was already retried as 20261116-041223-m3vc.
The input does not say why the stale low-disk hold had not cleared on its own.
prevention: Add a read-only preflight, for example `athena retry --check` or a hold-status view. It would report whether go or retry would be accepted for a held line, and whether the line was already retried, naming the retry job id. Hold messages would show that result in place of the generic hint. A stale hold would be cleared or flagged. The agent would run the preflight before stopping the drain.
proposed_request: Add a read-only preflight to Athena for held or interrupted lines. For a given line, `athena retry --check <id>` and `athena go --check` should state without changing anything whether the command would be accepted. If a command would be refused, the output should give the reason: the line was already retried (with the retry job id), or the hold is stale. Change the low-disk hold message to show this result instead of the line "retry does the same by hand". Re-evaluate low-disk holds so that a hold with enough free disk is released or marked stale. Acceptance: a test with a line already retried shows the check refusing with the retry id, and a test with a stale hold shows it reported as stale. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.
